initial_test_inference: Approximately 56 initial-state cases cached; no test score computed or read before this development extension
motivation: The initial three-round updater retained no rules; its feedback omitted plan/checker traces. A three-fact verification bottleneck is a researcher hypothesis to test, not an established cause.
researcher_changes: Expose plan, assessments, catalogue, observed/verified fact counts and reference differences to the reflector
Add a bounded all_observed fact-scope option to the verifier
agent_choices: Model proposes one observable conditional procedural card and selected/all_observed scope, or no edit; optional one schema repair
new_training_stream: Source training positions 72:144, disjoint from initial 72 cases; 3 rounds x 24 cases
promotion: Strictly higher mean of drug/Core4 F1 on proposal; neither guard drug nor Core4 F1 decreases
test_and_transfer: After all rounds freeze, evaluate all unique retained states on all 1082 cases; transfer final state to Llama without reselection
claims: Human repairs and menu design are separate from model-selected, gated state updates. No independent discovery or positive RSI is assumed. No test-best checkpoint selection.
reflector_input: Mechanically derived full-trace profiles for all discrepant training cases; raw traces remain local for audit; no drug names or literal target prescriptions in proposer input
